Write blocks.qs2 again from the saved results

Source: R/formatters.R
update_blocks.Rd

update_blocks() evaluates the blocks on the saved results of each scenario of the version, and writes blocks.qs2 of each one. It runs no analysis.

Usage

update_blocks(version = NULL, home = NULL)

Arguments

version

The version, for example "v01". The default NULL is the version of the last initialize_project() in this R session.

home

The project folder. The default NULL is the folder of the last initialize_project() in this R session.

Value

Invisibly, the names of the scenarios that it wrote.

Details

It does what step 7 of save_results() does, for each folder <version>_results/<scenario>/ that holds a results.qs2. In a one-file project, the folder of "real" is fake/, and update_blocks() does not change real/, the results of the server. See the section The folder fake/ of initialize_project(). It creates blocks.qs2 where it is absent. Call it after a change of the raw value of a block, or to create the files without a run. A change of a formatter needs no call, because show_block() and txt() format at each call. blocks.qs2 holds the raw value of each block.

It needs initialize_project() of version in this R session. It stops as save_results() does on a block that fails or that breaks the rule of block(). Then it writes no file.

See also

block(), show_block().
